# Pennyroyal — SGLang for Qwen3.8 on RTX PRO 6000

> Optimized SGLang runtime for Qwen3.8 Flash-Next NVFP4 with native NEXTN/FR-Spec and Qwen3.8-27B FP8 with DFlash2, HiCache and NIXL on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (SM120).

Canonical repository: https://github.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000

Both profiles use the same runtime source. The documented recipes use one GPU
and thinking-enabled agentic inference. Start with the Docker guide for a
prebuilt image or BUILD.md and RUN.md for native installation. Model weights
are downloaded separately. Detailed settings and dated measurements live in
the linked documents; this file is an index, not a second set of instructions.

The optional configurator is beta: `./configure-penny --native` or
`./configure-penny --container`. Use the saved settings and the generated launch
command; `--check` validates configuration without loading a model. See RUN.md
for HiCache RAM sizing and the NIXL soft disk budget. Both cache tiers remain
enabled. TP2 changes await verification from u/StockSpecialist1707.

## Start here

- [Beta configurator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/CONFIGURE.md): Guided native and container setup, saved settings, checks and launching.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/README.md): Model choices, release summary, performance tables and setup links.
- [Docker and Compose](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/docker/pennyroyal/README.md): Prebuilt image, host mounts, profile selection and startup.
- [Native build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/BUILD.md): Fresh installation, updates, dependencies and checkpoints.
- [Native launch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/RUN.md): Required paths, both launch profiles, API smoke checks and optional capacity/media settings.

## Optional features

- [Online FP8](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/FP8.md): Flash-Next precision changes, activation and measured speed/memory results.
- [NVMe PLE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/NVME-PLE.md): Move the PLE table from fixed host-RAM residency to an SSD-backed overlay.

- [Results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/RESULTS.md): Dated benchmarks and measurement definitions.

- [Changes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000/pennyroyal-main-sm120-final/CHANGES.md): Release fixes, affected profiles and upstream credit.

- [Validation suite](https://github.com/jpezzulli/pennyroyal-validation): Maintained reasoning, tool, vision and performance tests.
